snippet.title: We Are Rebellion - New Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: WE ARE REBELLION is a strategy and simulation game in which you command a warship with a crew of rebels. Use your weapons and tactics to destroy your enemies. Are you prepared to fight to the bitter end for a handful of credits? Remember, for the coward, flight remains a valid option. You could also sacrifice your crew in exchange for a few minutes’ respite.
